scope: Sixteen published study summaries. Access level is recorded so an abstract-based check is not represented as a full-text review. This is an editorial audit, not a guarantee that the original studies are error-free.

studies.review: 334 baseline, 249 follow-up, average 1.9 years. Observational structural/microstructural MRI associations; feature selection is not a causal effect or a reliable direction/size estimate for each exposure. Correct journal Part 1.

23 matched pairs, retrospective nonrandom room allocation. Mean postoperative stay 7.96 vs 8.70 days. Moderate/strong analgesic difference on days 2-5. Minor complications and antianxiety medication nonsignificant.

studies.access: Full paper PDF and publisher abstract
studies.review: Healthy volunteers, 32 in discovery experiment, replication and no-stress control experiments. Current urban residence relates to amygdala response; upbringing to pACC. No random assignment of life history and no clinical diagnoses. Specific design variables not tested.

studies.access: Publisher-indexed full-text methods/results and institutional record; full PDF not retrieved
studies.review: 18 adults, 200 interior photos across beauty and approach/avoidance runs. Curves favored for beauty with ACC response; contour did not significantly influence enter/leave decisions. No clinical outcome.

341 older adults, land use within 1 km. Forest association with latent MRI amygdala integrity; other land-use associations nonsignificant. Cross-sectional, not proof of protection or direct health score. Balanced title retains original URL.

63 healthy adults, randomized one-hour walks. Faces-task amygdala decrease after forest and stable urban response. MIST interaction significant but forest-only post hoc p=.070. Self-report, cognitive and physiological group-by-time interactions nonsignificant. Correct citation 27(11),4446-4452.

282 students, ten randomized VR arms. SCL and perceived restorativeness differed; HR and RMSSD did not. Coherence/complexity main effects on perceived restorativeness; physiological interaction rather than significant physiological main effects. Five-minute recovery is not long-term health evidence.

studies.access: Published abstract; publisher full text unavailable
studies.review: 426,220 dementia-free baseline, median 13.6 years, 3,513 AD and 864 MCI cases. Per-IQR green associations: AD relative risk 5.8% lower at 300m, 6.7% at 1000m; green/natural MCI 14.9-22.2% lower. Blue-space MCI nonsignificant. No invented model covariates, confidence intervals or causal prevention.

Six Finnish homes: five intervention, one control. 15g forest soil on rugs at weeks0/4/8. Localized bacterial signal strongest near rug at infant breathing height in first two weeks. Soil-specific fungal index null. No clinical benefit or brain outcome. Duration omitted because abstract and methods report different week counts.

studies.access: Publisher-indexed full-text sections; direct full text unavailable
studies.review: 41 recruited participants, 37 physiological analyses; real21/VR20. Counterbalanced sessions, living wall vs object-filled shelf. Task %HF difference significant, resting and cognitive comparisons nonsignificant. Positive-emotion ratings higher with living wall only in real environment; no baseline emotion comparison. No empty-room control or baseline emotion.

30 recruited, 23 analyzed; five one-minute VR scenes across days. Results section: frontal/central/parietal alpha differences; paper conclusion inconsistently names regions, so summary follows Results. Systolic BP/PRS effects; HR and diastolic BP null. Nonsignificance vs natural view/wall is not equivalence. Control is the same furnished office with blank foreground, not an empty room; architectural window view is the other built comparator.

75 children3-5, ten centers with group sizes36/16/23, 28days, no individual randomization. IL10:IL17A .86 to1.15, adjusted p=.04 intervention only. Skin Gammaproteobacterial diversity associations with TGF-beta1/Treg. Outcome-specific sample sizes smaller; no demonstrated disease prevention or brain effect.

studies.access: Publisher abstract/highlights and author preprint bibliographic record; full text unavailable
studies.review: Correct authors to Maestre et al. 95 homes, HVAC dust. Less development: greater bacterial richness; more development: greater fungal richness. Childhood-asthma homes: greater bacterial/lower fungal diversity. No blanket diversity benefit, causal microbe claim or invented effect sizes.

studies.access: Publisher abstract/highlights and institutional bibliographic record; full text unavailable
studies.review: Correct authors to Zähme et al. 63 adults, EEG street-photo appraisal. Green/built ratio (roads, sidewalks, towers and buildings in denominator) linked to more positive appraisals and P1; straight edges to N1; later P3/LPP to higher-order appraisal rather than basic affect. Sky and mean metric depth negative appraisal associations within stimulus set. No structural brain or clinical claim.

studies.access: Publisher abstract and PubMed record; full text unavailable
studies.review: Valid DOI, online21Oct2026, PMID42905620. 123 adults65-89, two weeks, assessments every two hours seven/day. Within-person preceding-two-hour green association moderated by reported stressors; between-person overall association. No invented coefficients/CIs or claim of a formally null no-stressor association.

studies.access: Bibliographic record only: University of Liverpool staff publication list (authors Zhang, X. & Du, J., volume 114, 26 pages, DOI) checked 2026-11-08. Publisher page, Crossref record and institutional repository eprint 3199779 not retrievable on 2026-11-07 or 2026-11-08; abstract and full text not read.
studies.review: Title and journal confirmed. Participant counts per experiment (132/126/134/96, sum 488) and outcome directions NOT yet verified against the abstract or full text. Title corrected to 'improve thinking, or only stress recovery'; dek softened from 'benefits' to short-term effects and from 'measurable' to 'significant'. 2026-11-08: authors and volume 114 confirmed from the author institution listing; volume added to the citation. Per-experiment counts, VR setting, randomization and all outcome directions remain NOT yet verified.
